subject.title: fix(cli): bound media input file reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: Should capability-CLI media input retain its existing unbounded acceptance behavior while receiving only the TOCTOU repair, or should OpenClaw adopt the proposed 100 MiB per-file and 500 MiB aggregate limits as a public CLI contract?
rationale: The new limits deliberately reject inputs that current behavior accepts, so code review cannot determine whether that compatibility change is intended product policy.

options.title: Separate the TOCTOU repair from the new limit policy
options.body: Preserve the current acceptance contract while implementing a descriptor-safe read, and propose any size limits separately with explicit product discussion.

options.title: Sponsor the limits as a CLI contract
options.body: Keep the 100 MiB and 500 MiB limits only with explicit maintainer approval, user-facing documentation, bounded-read enforcement, and compatibility-focused tests.

recommendation.title: Separate the TOCTOU repair from the new limit policy
recommendation.body: Preserve the current acceptance contract while implementing a descriptor-safe read, and propose any size limits separately with explicit product discussion.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main CLI ownership trail was available in the supplied review context.
